title: _brain
description: A brain that the engine calls: which topic is sent to which endpoint. Created by an external system (such as the AI Enhancement layer); the engine only reads it to know where to send events. Draft v0: the fields are a first proposal.

topic.description: The changes sent to this brain, as {entity}:{operation}, such as _work:create, _work:update or _work:delete. The topic of an event is its target entity and its operation.

endpoint.description: The address where the engine sends a matching event, such as the address an MCP server listens on. The engine calls it and expects process events back.

implementation.description: Which implementation of the brain it is (name and version), to tell which brain an endpoint belongs to. The port in endpoint changes at every start, so it cannot tell.

expiresAt.description: TTL of the brain. The creator renews it by extending this timestamp while it is alive; the engine ignores a brain whose expiresAt is in the past.
